upstream.pinSubject: test(gui-extensions): wait for worker rpc handlers to start before aborting (#55988)

closure.excludedPackagesReason: Only the Electron-rendered frontend (packages/app) and its transitive workspace closure are acquired. desktop/web are alternative renderers; core/server/cli/tui/sdk run the local service the phone never hosts; theme/httpapi-codegen/http-recorder are excluded tooling (see mobilePatches M-003); the rest is unrelated to the app build.

fileLevelExclusions.reason: HTTP recorder test fixtures; unused by the web build.

partialPackages.reason: Closure correction (correction loop, discovered at first V2 build): packages/app/vite.icons.ts reads ../desktop/icons/dev/* unconditionally at vite config load to emit favicons and webmanifest icons for the PWA. Only the dev-channel subtree is carried; the desktop package itself stays excluded and OPENCODE_CHANNEL=beta|prod builds are outside this vendor set.

mobilePatches.reason: Electron-only dev tooling (own tests/typecheck); electron postinstall pulls ~110MB binaries.

mobilePatches.summary: Server persistence encode path strips password (memory-only); marker string 'mobile(M-002): password stripped at encode (memory-only)' embedded in reachable encode code (M002.stripped counter).
mobilePatches.reason: Web platform default storage is localStorage; persisting credentials there violates AGENTS.md. Default delivery state must be memory-only. Keystore persistence is owned by issue #4.
mobilePatches.verification: V-cred(a) source grep + semantic probe against effect@4.0.1 (strip on encode, tolerance on decode); V-cred(b) marker found in built dist; G9 device check BLOCKED (no device).

mobilePatches.reason: Referenced packages are outside the acquired closure (generated code committed; theme not in runtime closure; http-recorder is a test tool). Bun 1.4.2 hard-errors on dangling workspace devDependencies and unsatisfied workspace peerDependencies.
